def load_module(name, digest, label):
    path = source(name,digest)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(label,path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def window_record(spec, root, *, check_science=True):
    path = checked(spec["model_window"],root)
    window = read(path)
    require(window["schema"] == MODEL_WINDOW_SCHEMA
            and window["source"]["sha256"] == file_sha(__file__)
            and window["call_number"] == spec["call_number"],
            "Actual current-call model clock source and address")
    for key in RUN_KEYS:
        require(window["run"][key] == os.environ.get(key),"Actual stage-clock run "+key)
    for left,right in ((window["actual_job_deadline"],spec["job_deadline"]),):
        require(left["bytes"] == right["bytes"] and left["sha256"] == right["sha256"],
                "No new job clock or altered source clock")
    clock=read(checked(spec["job_deadline"],Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]).resolve(strict=True)))
    until=clock["absolute_monotonic_deadline_ns"]-clock["readback_cleanup_reserve_seconds"]*10**9
    require(type(window["phase_deadline_monotonic_ns"]) is int
            and type(window["science_deadline_monotonic_ns"]) is int
            and window["science_deadline_monotonic_ns"] <= window["phase_deadline_monotonic_ns"]
            <= until-window["independent_audit_allowance_reserved_seconds"]*10**9,
            "Fixed stage window remains inside the actual original job deadline")
    if check_science and time.monotonic_ns() >= window["science_deadline_monotonic_ns"]:
        raise ResourceStop("The original projected-model scientific stage cap ended")
    return path,window

            "The actual per-call original physical source view is retained")

    require(physical_sources["schema"]=="R534-actual-current-physical-source-input-view-v1"
            and physical_sources["complete"] is True
            and physical_sources["call_number"]==spec["call_number"]
            and Path(physical_sources["actual_directory"]).resolve(strict=True)==physical_source_root,
            "This actual call copied the exact original physical source inputs")
    base=[sys.executable,"-u",str(source(COMPONENTS,COMPONENTS_SHA)),"--operator-components",
        "--packet",str(checked(spec["packet"],root)),"--expected-packet-sha256",spec["packet"]["sha256"],
        "--packet-binding",str(checked(spec["packet_binding"],root)),
        "--expected-packet-binding-sha256",spec["packet_binding"]["sha256"],
        "--owner-summary",str(handoff),"--expected-owner-summary-sha256",file_sha(handoff),
        "--owner-source",str(source(OWNER,OWNER_SHA)),"--expected-owner-source-sha256",OWNER_SHA,
        "--state",str(state),"--expected-state-sha256",file_sha(state),
        "--threads",str(spec["resources"]["owner"]["threads"]),"--retain-temporary-for-same-job"]

        "--expected-physical-packet-sha256",spec["physical_packet"]["sha256"],
        "--physical-binding",str(checked(spec["physical_binding"],root)),
        "--expected-physical-binding-sha256",spec["physical_binding"]["sha256"],

def current_owner(spec, root):
    owner_file=root/"owner"/"summary.json"
    owner=read(owner_file)
    require(owner["source_sha256"] == OWNER_SHA
            and owner["actual_call_identity"]["native_call"] == spec["call_number"],
            "Actual independent current owner source and call")
    final=owner.get("owner_final") or {}
    require(final.get("final",{}).get("complete") is True
            and final["final"].get("below_original_tolerance") is True
            and owner.get("independent_fresh_replay_complete") is True,
            "The original current128 primal/tolerance/replay must really have returned")
    post=owner.get("post_owner_components") or {}
    require(post["schema"] == "R534-truthful-post-owner-components-deferred-v1"
            and post["old_synchronous_post_components_executed"] is False,
            "The actual owner deferred, rather than fabricated, its old post components")
    handoff=member(owner_file.parent,post["actual_owner_handoff"])
    state=owner_file.parent/"solve"/"final-state.f128"
    require(receipt(state)["bytes"] == owner["final_state128"]["bytes"]
            and file_sha(state) == owner["final_state128"]["sha256"],
            "Actual unmodified complete final128 state")
    return owner_file,owner,handoff,state


def run_project(spec,root,remaining,record):
    _,window=window_record(spec,root)
    module=load_module(MODEL_BINDING,MODEL_BINDING_SHA,"_R534_current_projection_binding")
    input_spec=dict(schema=module.INPUT_SCHEMA,current_source_tuple=window["current_source_tuple"],
        owner_input=window["owner_input"],owner_summary=window["owner_summary"],
        session_spec=window["session_spec"],out=str(root/"projection"))
    input_file=root/"projection-input.json"
    write(input_file,input_spec)
    result,desc=module.bind_and_project(input_spec,input_receipt=receipt(input_file))
    record["actual_projection_binding"]=desc
    record["projection_complete"]=result.get("complete") is True
    record["projection_error"]=result.get("error")
    window_record(spec,root)
    if result.get("complete") is not True:
        raise RuntimeError("The actual once-RN64 current owner projection did not complete")
    return dict(projection_binding=desc,actual_projected_state64=result["actual_projected_state64"])

def run_guard(spec,root,remaining,record):
    """Independent original-owned process, only lifecycle metadata and signals."""
    path,window=window_record(spec,root,check_science=False)
    P=load_module(PROCESS,PROCESS_SHA,"_R534_original_owned_process")
    session=Path(read(checked(window["session_spec"],root.parent))["output"]).resolve(strict=True)
    require(root.parent == session and os.environ.get(P.ENV_NAMESPACE) == str(session),
            "The actual guard inherits the same registered worker namespace")
    worker_path=checked(window["worker_registry"],session)
    worker=read(worker_path)
    require(worker["schema"] == P.SCHEMA and worker["source"]["sha256"] == PROCESS_SHA
            and worker["run"] == record["run"] and Path(worker["namespace"]).resolve(strict=True) == session,
            "The actual original worker registry is source/run/namespace-bound")
    require(worker["deadline"]["bytes"] == spec["job_deadline"]["bytes"]
            and worker["deadline"]["sha256"] == spec["job_deadline"]["sha256"],
            "The registered worker uses this exact original deadline")
    me=P.proc_info(os.getpid(),session)
    require(me is not None and me["pid"] == me["pgid"] == me["sid"]
            and me["pid"] != worker["worker"]["pid"],
            "The guard is a distinct owned session, not the scientific worker group")
    registry=root/"model-phase"/"guard-process.json"
    P.register(SimpleNamespace(pid=os.getpid()),session,registry,sys.argv,spec["job_deadline"])
    record["actual_guard_registry"]=receipt(registry)
    record["actual_worker_registry"]=receipt(worker_path)
    signals=[]
    def stopped(signum,frame):
        signals.append(signum)
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):
        signal.signal(sig,stopped)
    write(root/"model-phase"/"guard-ready.json",dict(schema=MODEL_WINDOW_SCHEMA+"-guard-ready-v1",
        source=receipt(__file__),model_window=receipt(path),guard_registry=receipt(registry),
        actual_worker_registry=receipt(worker_path),run=record["run"]))
    stop_path=root/"model-phase"/"stop.json"
    while True:
        if stop_path.is_file():
            stop=read(stop_path)
            require(stop["schema"] == MODEL_WINDOW_SCHEMA+"-stop-v1"
                    and stop["model_window"]["sha256"] == file_sha(path)
                    and stop["run"] == record["run"]
                    and type(stop["model_completed"]) is bool,
                    "The same current Node explicitly closed this model scope")
            record["actual_stop"]=receipt(stop_path)
            record["model_completed_before_guard_close"]=stop["model_completed"]
            record["stop_reason"]="actual-current-Node-closed-model-scope"
            return dict(guard_completed=True,worker_group_termination_requested=False)
        current=P.proc_info(worker["worker"]["pid"],session)
        same=(current is not None and all(current[k] == worker["worker"][k]
               for k in ("pid","pgid","sid","start_ticks","uid")))
        if signals or not same or time.monotonic_ns() >= window["phase_deadline_monotonic_ns"]:
            record["stop_reason"]=("external-signal" if signals else
                "original-worker-no-longer-present" if not same else "original-stage-hard-wall-cap")
            record["actual_external_signals"]=signals
            record["resource_partial"]=True
            record["worker_group_quiet"]=P.quiet(worker_path,terminate=True)
            if not record["worker_group_quiet"]["quiescent"]:
                raise RuntimeError("Original owned worker group is not proved quiescent")
            return dict(guard_completed=True,worker_group_termination_requested=True,
                        model_completed_before_guard_close=False)
        time.sleep(0.05)
